importance: Telangana folk festival. The Bonalu festival at Balkampet Yellamma Temple starts after the Golconda Bonalu Jathara and Ujjaini Mahankali Bonalu Jathara.
description: Celebratory festival dedicated to Goddess Yellamma / Kali.

schedule.details: Devotees present 'Bonam'—sacred offerings consisting of cooked rice with milk, jaggery, and curd, intricately placed in brass or earthen pots adorned with neem leaves, turmeric, and vermilion.

importance: The marriage ceremony of the temple goddess, Yellamma.
description: Divine marriage ceremony of Goddess Yellamma.

schedule.details: Vedic marriage rituals performed by temple priests.

importance: Navaratri festival dedicated to the Goddess.
description: Special rituals and offerings during the Navaratri festival.

schedule.details: The goddess is intricately adorned in a unique incarnation dress/avatar each day, culminating in powerful Chandi Homam prayers for universal protection.
